span.p: requests cache through Mnemosyne's public interface

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE EDGE THAT MUST NOT EXIST
proteus and themis are invisible to mnemosyne by construction

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Mnemosyne — packages/mnemosyne — the memory subsystem, and THE research contribution

div.style: color: rgb(11, 45, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owns: KV cache, tiering, prefix reuse, compression, attribution telemetry.
Sizing target from the reference config: 2·48·8·128·2 B = 192.0 KiB per token,
so 24.0 GiB at 128k context against the ≥62 GiB fast tier

div.style: color: rgb(11, 45, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Public interface: three plug points —
write-time admission, deferred eviction, read-time selection.
One score-then-subset hook cannot host the existing literature

div.style: color: rgb(74, 74, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lethe — RESERVED, no code, no directory
the eviction-policy layer; the name is spent only once
there is more than one policy to hold

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owns: pre-registration, matched param and token budgets,
seed management ≥3, run execution, aggregation, confidence intervals

div.style: color: rgb(74, 74, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
argus/ — a module, not a package
telemetry: JSONL loss, LR, throughput, cache-stats
Reserved name; earns a package only if it outgrows the module

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
data/ — a module, not a package
seeded resumable loaders plus targeted recall and retrieval probes
Deliberately unnamed: no interface or lifecycle of its own yet

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owns: decoder, attention variants, MoE gating, positional schemes.
Every ablation axis is a config field; the config surface IS the experimental surface.
Reference shape read from laguna-s config.json: 48 layers as
12 full_attention plus 36 sliding_attention, sliding_window 512, 256 experts with 10 active

div.style: color: rgb(107, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BOUNDARY ENFORCEMENT — a mechanism, not discipline
packages/mnemosyne/pyproject.toml declares torch only — no proteus, no themis,
so an accidental import fails at dependency resolution rather than surviving review
tests/test_package_boundaries.py AST-walks packages/mnemosyne/src and fails,
naming the offending file, on any import of proteus or themis
Proved red-then-green 2026-07-26; separability itself is still untested until
the clean-venv wheel acceptance test runs at the mnemosyne-core milestone

div.style: color: rgb(49, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
docs/adr/ — decision records, frozen once Accepted
docs/adr/README.md is the register: slug, status, date, body SHA-256
tests/test_adr_immutability.py recomputes the hashes and fails on mismatch

div.style: color: rgb(49, 33, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ASSUMPTIONS.md — assumption, status, evidence, date
notebook/ — pre-registered hypothesis cards and results
Binding number for all KV work: fast tier ≥62 GiB at ~200 GB/s, measured 2026-07-26

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
torch — the only dependency Mnemosyne is permitted
2.12.0a0+rocm7.13.0a20260313 on gfx1151, native Windows
Single device: torch.distributed is absent from this build, so every parallelism path fails at import
